We would like to avoid pausing the POC (Comet Core) while we sort infra access with our identity team. Hi Samira —

Appreciate the heads-up. We can do either, and I'll outline pros/cons so procurement can decide quickly: 

- Top-up credits (recommended if you want minimal paperwork): one-off invoice for a token bucket that we apply to the existing POC. We can issue within 24 hours once you confirm amount. No change to dates or SOW.
- Short extension (recommended if you need extra calendar time for signoffs): 14-day amendment to the current POC SOW; no additional invoice if you keep within the original token cap, or we add a prorated token block if you expect extra usage. DocuSign turnaround typically 48–72 hours.

Numbers to consider (rough): 100k extra tokens for $1,200 (one-off credit), or a 14-day extension with a prorated 30% increase to the existing monthly cap if you expect sustained usage. I can get exact numbers from finance.

If procurement prefers credits, we can issue an invoice and credit code; if they want the extension we’ll send an amendment PDF for signature. Which direction should I push?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Procurement asked for the following to make a call: (a) exact price for the 100k token top-up, (b) sample amendment language for a 14-day extension, and (c) whether tokens carry across the extended window (i.e., if we extend, do unused tokens roll or expire?). Also need billing contact on your side for PO routing.

If possible, can you send both a one-page invoice option and a draft amendment so we can route both concurrently? That will shave a day off approval.

Appreciate it —

Hi Samira / team —

Adding the numbers you asked for and clarifying mechanics: 

1) 100k token top-up: $1,200 (one-off invoice). Tokens are additive to your existing POC bucket and expire 30 days after issuance. Invoice will reference DEAL-2025-376; billing contact: billing@redwood.ai. We can issue tomorrow EOD.

2) 14-day extension amendment: we will extend the evaluation window by 14 calendar days. Unused tokens from the original bucket will NOT automatically extend — the amendment can either: (A) carry forward unused tokens into the new window (policy: carry-forward requires explicit amendment language), or (B) leave tokens expiring on their original schedule while the timebox extends. If you want carry-forward, we’ll add a small administrative fee (waivable for first-time exceptions).

Attached is a draft amendment (POC_Amendment_v1.pdf) with both options A and B redlined; option A adds a $250 admin fee. Let us know preference and we’ll generate the final DocuSign.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
